last.verdict: Beyond Meat's margins hit a five-year high, but U.S. sales keep shrinking and the Q4 revenue guide of $54-59 million points lower still.

takeaways.label: Q4 sales guided lower
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue is guided to $54-59 million, down from $64.5 million in Q3. Management gave no cause beyond an uncertain operating environment, and no margin or cash outlook.

takeaways.label: Margins at five-year high
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 19.3%, up from 7.4%, on cost per pound down 10.1%. Management targets 30%+ long term but says low volumes still hold back the gains.

takeaways.label: U.S. still shrinking
takeaways.text: U.S. retail revenue fell 13.2% on volume down 20.8%, mainly lost club-store distribution. International retail grew 13.3%, a third straight rise, but international foodservice fell 19.4%.

takeaways.label: Cash burn slowed, debt remains
takeaways.text: Cash was $169.3 million, with nine-month operating cash use of $37.3 million versus $101.2 million. Debt is $313.9 million, and $14.5 million of notes mature March 2027 with no repayment plan found.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
